Flattening = E0428 duplicate definition. This is the load-bearing structural rule of the whole split.

EXECUTION-ORDER / SHARED-STATIC: admin_config.rs audit-stream tests (admin_audit_stream_enforces_per_admin_cap@8343, ..emits_frame_on_config_change@8410) rely on a module-static per-admin cap HashSet that persists across tests in-process (map note). Splitting into a sub-module does NOT change process scope (still one test binary) — SAFE. But the constraint that tests use unique usernames to avoid PersonId collision must be preserved verbatim. Same for fed_e multi_thread test relying on --test-threads=1 at runner level.

PROCESS-WIDE ENV + --test-threads=1: every domain mutates process env (LEMMY_DATABASE_URL, BREHON_DISABLE_*). Splitting into multiple tests/e2e/<domain>.rs files keeps them in ONE integration-test binary (single compile unit, single process), so --test-threads=1 still applies globally — SAFE. CRITICAL: must NOT create multiple top-level tests/*.rs files (that would make separate binaries and break the single-process env contract). The thin-root tests/e2e.rs + tests/e2e/ subdir pattern guarantees one binary.
